name: Insecure Deserialization
essence: Hydrating untrusted input straight into live objects runs code and sets state the caller never wrote.

examples.summary: JSON from the request sets Admin to true.
examples.mechanism: The exported field is part of the decode target, so the body writes it (CWE-915).

examples.summary: A string quantity decodes as 0 because the error is ignored.
examples.mechanism: Unmarshal fails the type mismatch and the blank assignment keeps the zero Qty (CWE-502).

examples.summary: A nested flags object sets Admin, and the unknown note is ignored.
examples.mechanism: Without DisallowUnknownFields, extra keys are skipped and nested exported fields are still written (CWE-915).
examples.expected_behavior: unknown field rejected, admin left false

examples.summary: A hand-rolled decoder sets admin from the input text.
examples.mechanism: Every key in the line is applied, including a flag the caller should not write (CWE-915).

examples.summary: A length prefix consumes the following flag byte as part of the name.
examples.mechanism: The length is taken from the buffer and not checked against the field that follows (CWE-502).

examples.summary: Object.assign copies role admin from the body onto the record.
examples.mechanism: Every enumerable field on the body overwrites the record, including role (CWE-915).

examples.summary: Assigning the __proto__ key sets the record's prototype, so role reads as admin.
examples.mechanism: The key is an own property of the parsed object and [[Set]] on __proto__ changes the prototype (CWE-915).

examples.summary: The reviver turns the admin string true into a boolean.
examples.mechanism: The reviver rewrites every value equal to "true", including a flag (CWE-502).

examples.summary: Parsed data supplies constructor, so kind reads as Array.
examples.mechanism: An own constructor property shadows the one inherited from Object (CWE-915).

examples.summary: The body sets admin to True through setattr.
examples.mechanism: Every key in the body is written onto the object. admin is not reserved.

examples.summary: User(**data) takes admin from the body and stores True.
examples.mechanism: Splatting a dict into the constructor binds every matching parameter, including the flag.

examples.summary: A nested flags object sets admin to True.
examples.mechanism: The loader copies the nested admin field onto the user with no allow-list.

examples.summary: dict.update overwrites admin with True from the body.
examples.mechanism: update copies every key. A flag already on the record is not protected.
